intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} are two of the best-known {{course}} campuses in Delhi, but they are not substitutes for each other. This page compares official fees, recorded placements and NIRF 2025 Engineering ranks, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
DTU vs IIT Delhi starts with the entrance test. IIT Delhi admits undergraduate students through JEE Advanced and is ranked 2 in NIRF 2025 Engineering. DTU admits through JEE Main and is ranked 30.

sections.heading: DTU vs IIT Delhi for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIT Delhi if you can clear JEE Advanced and want the higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 2, plus the only 2020 or later placement record on this page.
Choose DTU if you are targeting JEE Main and a strong Delhi public university. DTU is ranked 30 in NIRF 2025 Engineering, but this page does not have a 2020 or later flagship placement row for it.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: IIT Delhi's official 2025-26 prospectus lists B.Tech tuition of ₹1,00,000 per semester, or ₹2,00,000 a year, for General, OBC-NCL and EWS students with family income above ₹5 lakh. Income-linked remissions and a full tuition waiver for SC, ST and PwD students also apply.

The official 2025-entry fee circular shows a first-semester institute fee of ₹1,31,000 with hostel residence for the full-tuition category, including other charges, a one-time payment, a refundable deposit and residence fees. Our records still show an older annual total of ₹2.49 lakh, which should be read against that official circular, not as a four-year total.

DTU's recorded figures on this page include tuition of ₹1,71,750 a year and year-wise totals between ₹2.19 lakh and ₹2.36 lakh on a lateral-entry programme. DTU publishes an annual fee notification on its website; confirm the current circular before you budget, because we could not open the 2025-26 PDF in this pass.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IIT Delhi's recorded 2024 figures on this page are an average package of ₹25 lakh and a highest package of ₹200 lakh. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

DTU's latest recorded placement year here is 2018, with an average of ₹25 lakh and a highest of ₹39 lakh. Because that year is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result.
Ask DTU for its latest official placement report. Do not compare a 2018 DTU row with IIT Delhi's 2024 figures as if they described the same year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: IIT Delhi admits B.Tech and dual-degree students through JEE Advanced, after JEE Main, via JoSAA counselling. A qualifying Class 12 performance is also required, as set out in the JEE Advanced information brochure.
DTU admits undergraduate engineering students through JEE Main, via the Joint Admission Counselling (JAC) Delhi process for its Delhi and outside-Delhi seats.
You cannot move from a DTU JEE Main seat to IIT Delhi without a JEE Advanced rank. Plan the exam path first, then compare campuses.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Delhi, but in different parts of the city. IIT Delhi is at Hauz Khas in South Delhi. DTU is at Shahbad Daulatpur, Bawana Road, in North-West Delhi.
If you want to stay in Delhi, the choice is about the entrance test, the NIRF standing and the official fee, not about leaving the city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you have a JEE Advanced rank and want the NIRF 2025 Engineering rank 2 campus, IIT Delhi is the stronger fit on every official measure this page can show.
If you are in the JEE Main / JAC Delhi pool, DTU is the relevant campus here, with a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 30. Ask DTU for a current placement report, because this page only holds a 2018 row.
For fees, use IIT Delhi's official semester circular and DTU's current annual notification, not the lowest raw row in the detailed table.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, DTU or IIT Delhi, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: IIT Delhi is ranked 2 in NIRF 2025 Engineering and admits through JEE Advanced. DTU is ranked 30 and admits through JEE Main and JAC Delhi. They are not interchangeable. IIT Delhi also has the only 2020 or later placement record on this page, from 2024.

faqs.question: What are the official B.Tech fees for IIT Delhi vs DTU?
faqs.answer: IIT Delhi's official 2025-26 tuition is ₹1,00,000 per semester, or ₹2,00,000 a year, for General, OBC-NCL and EWS students with family income above ₹5 lakh, with remissions and waivers as published. Our records still list an older annual total of ₹2.49 lakh. DTU's recorded tuition here is ₹1,71,750 a year; confirm DTU's current official annual fee notification.

faqs.question: Does DTU accept JEE Advanced, or only JEE Main?
faqs.answer: DTU lists JEE Main and admits through JAC Delhi. IIT Delhi requires JEE Advanced. A JEE Main rank alone is not enough for IIT Delhi.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for DTU and IIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: IIT Delhi's recorded 2024 average is ₹25 lakh and the highest is ₹200 lakh. DTU's latest recorded year here is 2018, which this page does not treat as a current flagship result. Ask DTU for its latest official report.

faqs.question: Are DTU and IIT Delhi in the same part of Delhi?
faqs.answer: Both are in Delhi, but not in the same neighbourhood. IIT Delhi is at Hauz Khas. DTU is at Shahbad Daulatpur, Bawana Road, in North-West Delhi.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Confirm the current JEE Advanced and JAC Delhi brochures, IIT Delhi's fee circular and DTU's annual fee notification before you apply or pay.
